chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"I do not refrain from food that a cat has eaten from, nor from drink that it has drunk from."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Is food or drink touched by a cat considered impure in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that food and drink from which a cat has partaken are not to be avoided. It is used in discussions of ritual purity and impurity, showing lenience regarding the leftovers of a cat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.11 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"I do not refrain from food that a cat has tasted, nor from drink that it has sipped."
